# Basin

> Basin is an Android app that reads supported payment notifications, shows where your
> money went, and shows how long the money lasts until payday. Exact transaction amounts
> stay on the device.

## What Basin does

- Reads supported payment notifications from bank and payment apps.
- Shows a day-by-day runway to your next payday, set against your salary day.
- Shows likely recurring charges and a shareable Basin Card that carries percentages only.
- Keeps exact transaction amounts on the device. Only an anonymous bracketed range is
  sent if you opt in to spend benchmarks.

## Pricing

- Free: runway to payday and subscription tracking, always.
- Premium: AED 19.99 per month, with a 14-day free trial.
